integrity: The lower bound is analytic. The finite checker is used only after analytic reductions force two half-integral areas and a finite set of possible squared lattice side lengths.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the translated Euclidean unit disk, the square lattice, and exactly three illuminating lattice points; no classification of all asymptotically extremizing triangles is claimed.
title: Sharp three-point square-lattice illumination distance for the unit disk
